phase: Exploratory follow-up on a previously inspected public dataset; frozen before new intervention results, not an independent holdout.

performance.flow_risk: CPU-only independent scoring and diagnostic evaluation of 500 fixed public images; no library/database/model writes and no GPU use.
performance.approach_bounds: Reuse cached 2048D vectors, at most 500 images x 12 queries per scheme; evaluate each candidate once. No all-library scan, no model load, no label-guided crop.
performance.validation_stop: Verify all input hashes/identities, finite vectors and exact full-set rankings; stop on identity mismatch or malformed output. Report elapsed CPU analysis only, not application latency.

primary_quality: macro AP across the eight completely annotated categories
cat AP and relevant-item rank distribution over all 500 images
subset_policy: Filter full scores/rankings to the fixed subset, then recompute metrics. Do not substitute different samples or remove failures.
area_policy: Use sample category_max_area_fraction, the largest COCO annotated instance area divided by image area. Diagnostic recall and positive rank over the unchanged full candidate pool only; do not count positives in other area groups as negatives or feed annotations into preprocessing. Zero/unknown separately reported; no subgroup AP claims.
tradeoff_policy: Keep per-category AP/precision/recall and all seven non-cat regressions. Compare quality against encoding/query wall time, VRAM, index size and whether an index rebuild is required. No single-score winner or automatic production default change.
candidate_bound: Query wording/ensemble, image pixel budget, deterministic label-free crops and bounded reranking are exploratory configurations with separate identities. No tuning to individual asset IDs or ground-truth boxes.
limits: Labels describe COCO object presence, not dominant subject; incomplete annotations and cat depictions are possible.
The four quantity/color/action/relation queries lack complete labels and receive no AP/precision/recall claims.
Top100 on a 500-image subset is not recall in a 300k private library.
All sample images are at most 640 pixels per side; higher input pixel experiments here cannot establish behavior on full-resolution phone originals.
No data-independent statistical significance or real-library quality is claimed; random and targeted strata stay separately visible.

reranker_sensitivity.method: Reuse the same independent query-image scores from the frozen 8x100 experiment. For each K, rerank only the original top K by descending raw yes-minus-no logit, then ascending numeric asset ID for exact ties; append baseline ranks K+1..500 unchanged.
required_invariants: Recall@K and Precision@K unchanged by reranking the same K
reranker_sensitivity.cost: Sum actual per-pair total_ms for the original top K, per query, plus separately reported model loading; subset sums are an observed component-cost estimate, not a separately executed end-to-end request or concurrency guarantee.
limits: Top20 reranking cannot improve P20, only ordering inside it
Top100 cannot rescue a relevant photo originally ranked beyond100
sigmoid values are model scores, not calibrated relevance probabilities
no extra GPU pairs and no change to the original Top100 plan
